# GAATSCO

> GAATSCO is an accounting, tax, and business advisory firm founded in 2025, serving founders, startups, SMEs, and NRIs across India and the USA. We help clients resolve compliance faster, close their books with confidence, and scale with clear financial direction.

## What GAATSCO does

- **Accounting & Bookkeeping** — day-to-day bookkeeping, ledger maintenance, and reconciliation.
- **India Taxation** — income tax filing, GST registration and returns, TDS/TCS, corporate tax, tax planning, and assessment support.
- **US Taxation** — federal and state returns for individuals and businesses, tax planning, payroll taxes, and cross-border India–USA support.
- **Audit Support** — documentation preparation, compliance review, internal control evaluation, on-site support, and post-audit consultation.
- **Payroll Management** — salary processing, payslips, and PF/ESI/TDS compliance.
- **Financial Statements** — preparation of balance sheet, P&L, and cash flow, plus ratio/trend analysis and management reporting.
- **Web Development** — modern, SEO-ready business websites, landing pages, e-commerce, and custom web applications, plus ongoing maintenance and support.

## Who GAATSCO serves

Founders, startups, small and medium-sized businesses (SMEs), and NRIs (non-resident Indians) managing businesses across India and the USA.

## Key facts

- Founded: 2025
- Offices: Hyderabad, India (8-1-299/B, RP Business Park, Shaikpet, 500008) and Manchester, New Hampshire, USA (311 S Mammoth Rd)
